## TemplateEngine.validatePositionsBlock() method

Validates block positioning and nesting rules in a template string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static validatePositionsBlock(template: string): {
        valid: boolean;
        errors: Array<{
            line: number;
            message: string;
        }>;
    };
```

## Remarks

This method checks a template string for structural block nesting violations. It ensures that blocks are placed in their allowed parent contexts.

\*\*Nesting hierarchy:\*\*

```
__root__
  ├── base             (root level only)
  │   ├── message      (content block)
  │   │   ├── switch   (logic block)
  │   │   │   ├── case
  │   │   │   └── default
  │   │   ├── map      (logic block)
  │   │   ├── script   (logic block)
  │   │   └── space    (utility)
  │   ├── keyboard     (content block)
  │   │   ├── switch   (logic block)
  │   │   │   ├── case
  │   │   │   └── default
  │   │   ├── map      (logic block)
  │   │   ├── script   (logic block)
  │   │   └── space    (utility)
  │   ├── media        (content block)
  │   │   ├── switch   (logic block)
  │   │   │   ├── case
  │   │   │   └── default
  │   │   ├── map      (logic block)
  │   │   ├── script   (logic block)
  │   │   └── space    (utility)
  │   ├── description  (content block)
  │   │   ├── switch   (logic block)
  │   │   │   ├── case
  │   │   │   └── default
  │   │   ├── map      (logic block)
  │   │   ├── script   (logic block)
  │   │   └── space    (utility)
  │   ├── import       (utility)
  │   ├── description  (utility)
  │   ├── script       (logic block)
  └   └── space        (utility)
```
\*\*Enforced rules:\*\* - `<base>` must be at the outermost level and cannot be nested inside any other block. - `<message>`<!-- -->, `<keyboard>`<!-- -->, `<media>`<!-- -->, `<media-group>`<!-- -->, `<description>`<!-- -->, `<import>`<!-- -->, `<script>`<!-- -->, `<space>` can only appear directly inside `<base>`<!-- -->. - `<media>` can also appear directly inside `<media-group>` as a group item. - `<switch>`<!-- -->, `<map>` can only appear inside `<message>`<!-- -->, `<keyboard>`<!-- -->, `<media>`<!-- -->, or `<description>`<!-- -->. - `<case>` and `<default>` can only appear inside `<switch>`<!-- -->. - Telegram formatting tags (`<b>`<!-- -->, `<i>`<!-- -->, `<u>`<!-- -->, `<s>`<!-- -->, `<code>`<!-- -->, `<pre>`<!-- -->, `<a>`<!-- -->, `<blockquote>`<!-- -->, `<blockquote expandable>`<!-- -->) are passthrough and ignored during validation.

## Example


```typescript
// Valid template
const result = TemplateEngine.validatePositionsBlock(`
  <base>
    <message>Hello {{name}}!</message>
    <keyboard>Yes, No</keyboard>
  </base>
`);
// Result: { valid: true, errors: [] }

// Invalid: <base> nested inside <message>
const bad = TemplateEngine.validatePositionsBlock(`
  <base>
    <message>
      <base>Nested base</base>
    </message>
  </base>
`);
// Result: { valid: false, errors: [{ line: 4, message: 'Block <base> is not allowed inside <message>' }] }
```
